mods/embeddium.pw.toml.reason: Superseded by Sodium, the renderer Iris requires on NeoForge; Embeddium and Sodium cannot be installed together.

mods/oculus.pw.toml.name: Iris Shaders
mods/oculus.pw.toml.reason: Oculus has no NeoForge 1.21.1 build; Iris 1.8.14-beta.1 is the supported NeoForge shader loader (survey replacement).

mods/create-steam-n-rails.pw.toml.name: Create: Steam 'n' Rails (NeoForge port)
mods/create-steam-n-rails.pw.toml.reason: Official project has no NeoForge 1.21.1 build; unofficial NeoForge port 0.3.0-beta.2 (survey replacement), vetted against Create's version by the dependency check.

mods/culllessleaves-reforged.pw.toml.name: Cull Less Leaves (NeoForge port)
mods/culllessleaves-reforged.pw.toml.reason: Reforged has no NeoForge 1.21.1 build; the NeoForge port 1.4.3 (survey replacement) requires Kotlin for Forge, already in the pack. Pinned by sha256 because the release tag name is not versioned.

mods/hourglass.pw.toml.reason: Modrinth metadata lacks the 1.21.1 tag; the exact NeoForge 1.21.1 file is on CurseForge (survey cross-check).

mods/ranged-pumps.pw.toml.reason: Modrinth only tags 1.21; CurseForge tags the same file for 1.21.1 (survey cross-check).

mods/radium-reforged.pw.toml.reason: Create 6.0.10's neoforge.mods.toml declares radium incompatible (FML refuses to load both); Create is core content. Revisit if a later Create build lifts it.

additions.name: Sodium
additions.reason: Required by Iris 1.8.14-beta.1 (its Modrinth dependency pins this version); replaces Embeddium.

additions.name: Prickle
additions.reason: Required by AttributeFix and Enchantment Descriptions ([21.1,21.2)); Darkhax config library split out for 1.21.

additions.name: Lionfish API
additions.reason: Required by L_Ender's Cataclysm (declares 3.1); 3.1 is the newest NeoForge 1.21.1 release.

additions.name: Mekanism
additions.reason: Plan Phase 7 (Interstellaris stack), first in dependency order: Mekanism 10.7.19.85, inside Interstellaris 0.6.1's published range 10.7.19-10.7.x. The main jar, not the -api file.

additions.name: Mekanism Generators
additions.reason: Plan Phase 7: Mekanism Generators 10.7.19.85 (pairs with Mekanism 10.7.19.85, its Modrinth dependency); required by Interstellaris 0.6.1.

additions.name: Sable
additions.reason: Plan Phase 7, second in dependency order: Sable 2.0.6 (moving-sublevel physics; bundles Veil 4.3.2, Sable Companion 1.6.0 and its Rapier physics library), inside Interstellaris 0.6.1's range 2.0.5-2.0.x. Declares Sodium >= 0.8.12-alpha.2 (pack: 0.8.13) and is incompatible with ScalableLux (absent).

additions.name: Interstellaris
additions.reason: Plan Phase 7, last in dependency order: Interstellaris 0.6.1 beta (2026-10-27, WIP space mod; full release estimated Q2 2027). Requires Mekanism + Generators [10.7.19,10.8) and Sable [2.0.5,2.1), both pinned; CurseForge only (no Modrinth project).

frozen.reason: Agreed with minecraft-mods: the seven ports build against NeoForge 21.1.265, JEI 19.70.0.464, EMI 1.1.24, Polymorph 1.2.0 and Dank Storage 20.
